one_line: Founder of the Shunga dynasty during the Indo-Greek pressures on northern India.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s to early 50s, solid medium-tall build with the presence of a seasoned commander.
appearance.face: Angular oval face with a strong jaw, sharp nose, medium-brown north Indian complexion, neatly trimmed moustache with a short close beard along the jawline, deep-set intimidating eyes with thick brows, default expression a stern, calculating calm with a hint of severity.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair pulled back into a high, tight topknot (śikhā-style) at the crown, sides combed back smoothly, no loose fringe; wears a plain deep-red cloth turban band wrapped low around the topknot like a narrow headcloth, with a small gold disc ornament centered at the forehead.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-2nd century BCE Magadhan royal-military outfit: a long, calf-length wrapped upper garment resembling an early uttariya/angarkha in muted cream, crossing left over right and tied with a narrow dark-brown cord at the waist; over this a sleeveless, fitted, quilted vest of thick cotton or leather in deep red with simple vertical stitching, giving subtle armour-like padding; lower body clad in straight, ankle-length, tightly wrapped dhoti-style garment in muted saffron with a narrow dark-green border, pleated neatly at the front; a broad dark-green cloth waistband (mekhala) wraps over the cord, with one end hanging; over the left shoulder a dark-olive shawl (uttariya) edged in thin gold stripe, usually draped back to keep arms free; feet in simple brown leather sandals with ankle straps; minimal jewellery: a pair of small gold hoop earrings, one slim gold armlet on the right upper arm, and a single plain gold ring on his right hand.
appearance.signature: A long iron-tipped spear (approximately his height) with a leaf-shaped blade and dark wooden shaft wrapped in deep-red cloth near the grip, often held upright in his right hand and occasionally resting its butt on the ground beside him.

ref_desc: Pushyamitra Shunga is a stern, medium-brown, strong-jawed man in his early 50s with a dark topknot wrapped in a deep-red headband, wearing a cream wrap tunic under a deep-red quilted vest, saffron dhoti, dark-green shawl and waistband, simple gold jewellery, brown sandals, and always carrying a tall leaf-bladed spear with a dark wooden shaft wrapped in red cloth near the grip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Pushyamitra Shunga: a late-40s to early-50s medium-tall man with a strong jaw, sharp nose, deep-set stern eyes, medium-brown north Indian complexion, and a neatly trimmed moustache with a short close beard; his dark brown-black hair is pulled into a tight high topknot, sides smoothed back, with a narrow deep-red cloth headband wrapped around the base and a small round gold disc centered at the forehead. He wears an era-accurate mid-2nd century BCE Magadhan royal-military outfit: a calf-length, cream-coloured wrapped upper garment crossing left over right and tied at the waist, over which sits a sleeveless, fitted, quilted deep-red vest with vertical stitching, and an ankle-length, tightly wrapped saffron dhoti with a narrow dark-green border. A broad dark-green cloth waistband wraps his waist with one end hanging, and a dark-olive shawl edged with a thin gold stripe is draped from his left shoulder and swept back to keep his arms free. Show simple gold hoop earrings, a single gold armlet on his right upper arm, a plain gold ring on his right hand, and brown leather sandals with ankle straps. He holds his signature long spear as tall as he is, with a leaf-shaped iron blade, a dark wooden shaft, and a band of deep-red cloth wrapping near the grip; emphasize the dominant colours deep red, muted cream, saffron, dark green, and dark brown, and present him in front, side, and back poses plus a close-up of his stern, calculating face and topknot-headband combination.
